# Public-data correspondence for context-sensitive updating

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`context-sensitive-updating-correspondence` · **reviewed-scoped** · assessment · F04 · [record](context-sensitive-updating-correspondence.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> Reanalysis of 24 participants supports an increased perturbation contrast across training and a post-training cue effect; an acquired increase in the cue effect is uncertain and its later finite-window effect is weaker.

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- Use author-processed trial coefficients, cue/direction mapping and published Fig3 windows; no independent raw-force preprocessing reconstruction or COIN refit.
- Complete 24-person sample, participant bootstrap, and Holm adjustment for three change tests; other intervals/sensitivities are exploratory and phase change does not isolate every causal effect of training.
- Check ranges, local fragment hashes and redundant tables for all 24; only participant 24 also has a complete-file deposited-hash check. Two absent source trial numbers for participant 13 lie outside the analysed triplets and are preserved with an omission sensitivity.

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- It does not identify a unique latent mechanism.
- It does not identify infinite convergence.
- It does not identify complete situational understanding, arbitrary new concepts or autonomous final goals.
- It does not provide full cross-scale biological joint validation.
- **Counterexample:** Cue-change interval includes zero; later cue influence is weaker and the cue contrast within P− is uncertain. Phase/time and latent-retrieval alternatives remain. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/inquiry-correspondence/situated-recovery/MEMORY-UPDATING.md)

## Progress

Updating correspondence: the 24-person reanalysis tests cue × perturbation contrasts, their pre/post changes and finite persistence, linking experimental history to the distinction of formation, current use and continuing adequacy. <a id="evidence--证据"></a>
## Evidence

51,152 rows, 7,008 measurements and 2,304 triplets; grouping matches a separate translation of author code and five published statistics. Verify 48 original fragments and one complete original; substantive self-review, no independent sample/review or new Lean theorem.

Canonical source: [MEMORY-UPDATING.md](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/inquiry-correspondence/situated-recovery/MEMORY-UPDATING.md)

<a id="next--下一步"></a>
## Next

Use observations/manipulations in existing studies that distinguish memory revision, expression changes and deliberate correction, advancing toward reflective model and goal revision.

<details><summary>Correspondence, dependencies, sources and history</summary>

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

7,008 channel measurements and 2,304 triplets connect established experimental history to subsequent expressed updates. Formation, current effect and persistence remain distinct; the expressed difference is not direct latent-memory readout.
